tools.name: generate_dental_treatment_plan_pdf
tools.description: Start the real Toofi headless treatment-plan pipeline from structured clinical findings: create a service-user runtime plan, invoke AI plan generation, and return an operation id for polling toward a patient-facing PDF output.

request_id.description: Idempotency and correlation id echoed in Toofi responses.

mandate_id.description: Clinic or agent mandate id. Optional in public demo mode.

principal_id.description: Human or clinic principal on whose behalf the agent acts.

clinic_id.description: Clinic identifier for mandate-scoped production execution.

runtime_session_token.description: Toofi runtime actor token for service-user scoped execution. May also be supplied as x-toofi-session-token header.

agent_key.description: Toofi agent API key. May also be supplied as X-Toofi-Agent-Key header.

external_id.description: Agent-side patient reference. Avoid PHI unless your mandate permits it.

position.description: FDI tooth id, e.g. 36 or tooth-36.

state.description: Tooth state such as missing, caries, healthy, crown.

include_ai_narrative.description: Pass-through flag for the existing Toofi AI narrative pipeline. Defaults to true in the headless wrapper.

priceAdjustmentPercent.description: Existing Toofi presentation build option passed through to the runtime presentation pipeline.

showDiscount.description: Existing Toofi presentation build option passed through to the runtime presentation pipeline.

pdf_options.description: Pass-through PDF options for the existing Toofi PDF renderer.
